page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn6e.24xlarge is a GPU-accelerated bare metal instance designed for intensive parallel computing workloads. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding 8.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance is built on the KVM hypervisor.

The primary hardware highlight is the inclusion of eight NVIDIA V100 GPUs, providing a combined total of 256 GB of VRAM. This massive GPU capability is complemented by a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. The instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage must be provisioned externally.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.ebmgn6e.24xlarge represents a high-density resource allocation model where the cost is driven by the dense integration of eight enterprise-grade GPUs and a large memory footprint. This makes it highly suitable for workloads such as deep learning training, complex scientific simulations, high-performance computing, and large-scale data parallel processing.
